subject.title: fix(qqbot): require own account credential entries

question: Should QQBot formally treat only own enumerable account and credential properties as supported programmatic configuration, even when this stops prototype-inherited values from resolving?
rationale: The patch is mechanically consistent across the affected paths, but it intentionally removes a previously accepted JavaScript object-shape behavior that cannot be represented in normal JSON or JSON5 configuration.

options.title: Adopt own-only configuration
options.body: Approve the stricter boundary because file-backed OpenClaw configuration cannot encode prototype inheritance and the rule avoids inherited credential ambiguity.

options.title: Preserve inherited programmatic values
options.body: Keep the prior behavior and redesign the cleanup fix so it does not change resolution semantics for prototype-based programmatic callers.

recommendation.title: Adopt own-only configuration
recommendation.body: Approve the stricter boundary because file-backed OpenClaw configuration cannot encode prototype inheritance and the rule avoids inherited credential ambiguity.
